text: At 57 minutes, Ironvale Athletic executed a tactical transition into control by deploying a low block and deep defensive line in their 5-3-2 formation, facilitating defensive solidity and quick vertical transitions on the counter. This structure triggered a press-release mechanism against Redmond Rovers’ high defensive line, exploiting space behind them and generating 3 final third entries, 3 shots, and 0.2 xG in an 8-minute window despite holding only 42.2% possession and a higher PPDA of 8.8, reflecting selective pressing intensity. Their ability to absorb Redmond’s high press and quick circulation, which induced 2 high turnovers in dangerous areas, enabled effective rest-defense and transition phases, culminating in 11 box touches compared to 5 for Redmond and multiple shot attempts by Lindqvist and Lindgren. Ironvale’s field tilt of 55.6% in this period contrasts Redmond’s 44.4%, underscoring their spatial and tactical dominance despite lower overall possession.
